description: This file defines the TeamService class with methods for managing team invitations, membership, deletion, and related operations in a project, including external service interactions and database transactions.

classes.name: TeamService
classes.description: Provides static methods for managing teams, including creating invites, deleting teams, managing members, and handling invitations.

methods.name: createInvite
methods.description: Creates an invitation token for a team and generates an invite link, optionally using an existing token.

methods.name: buildInviteLink
methods.description: Constructs an invite link, including onboarding callback if applicable.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a team, handling external billing, internal cleanup, and domain removal.

methods.name: removeMembers
methods.description: Removes multiple users from specified teams, updating billing accordingly.

methods.name: inviteMemberByToken
methods.description: Invites a user to a team using a verification token.

methods.name: acceptTeamMembership
methods.description: Accepts a team membership invitation and updates user profile if needed.

methods.name: leaveTeamMembership
methods.description: Removes a user from a team, logging seat removal if applicable.

methods.name: acceptInvitationByToken
methods.description: Accepts a team invitation using a token, verifying user identity.

methods.name: removeMember
methods.description: Removes a member from a team or organization, handling related cleanup.

methods.name: fetchMembershipOrThrow
methods.description: Fetches a membership record or throws if not found.

methods.name: fetchTeamOrThrow
methods.description: Fetches a team record or throws if not found.

methods.name: fetchUserOrThrow
methods.description: Fetches a user record or throws if not found.

methods.name: cleanupTempOrgRedirect
methods.description: Cleans up temporary organization redirect data for a user.

methods.name: removeFromOrganization
methods.description: Removes a user from an organization, including sub-teams and profile cleanup.

methods.name: removeFromTeam
methods.description: Removes a user from a team, cleaning up related event types and memberships.
